en: Add the production AgentWorker, SessionRunner, EffectDispatcher, and ExecutionHost recovery loop; move PostgreSQL and OpenTelemetry adapters to explicit optional entrypoints.
zh-CN: 新增生产级 AgentWorker、SessionRunner、EffectDispatcher 与 ExecutionHost 恢复闭环；将 PostgreSQL 和 OpenTelemetry adapter 移至显式可选入口。
